app.name: Machine Learning Playgrounds
app.tagline: Upload data, build a model, and keep the whole process as a portfolio.

tasks.title: To do
tasks.allDone: Everything in this step is done.

data.label: Data
data.purpose: Upload a table and see what columns it has.

preprocess.label: Preprocessing
preprocess.purpose: Decide what to predict from what, and tidy the data.

train.label: Training
train.locked: Choose what to predict and which algorithms to use first.
train.purpose: Train every algorithm you picked in one go.

results.label: Results
results.locked: This opens once a training run has finished.
results.purpose: Compare the numbers and see what changed them.

predict.label: Prediction
predict.locked: No model is available to predict with yet.
predict.purpose: Put in new values and see what the model says.

portfolio.label: Portfolio
portfolio.purpose: Write up what you did and what you found.

errors.REQUEST_INVALID: The request is not in the expected format. Check: {fields}
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: That request method is not allowed here.
errors.DATASET_TOO_LARGE: The data file is too large. (limit {limitMb}MB, yours {actualMb}MB)
errors.DATASET_PARSE_FAILED: The data could not be read. Please check the file format.
errors.DATASET_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED: That text encoding is not supported. ({encoding})
errors.COLUMN_NOT_FOUND: That column is not in the data. ({column})
errors.TARGET_NOT_SELECTED: Choose the column you want to predict.
errors.TARGET_NOT_NUMERIC: Regression predicts numbers, but that column has values that are not numbers. Choose classification, or predict a different column. ({target})
errors.TARGET_SINGLE_CLASS: The target column has only one value, so it cannot be classified. ({target})
errors.TARGET_TOO_MANY_CLASSES: Too many classes to predict. (limit {limitClasses}, yours {actualClasses})
errors.FEATURE_NOT_SELECTED: Choose at least one feature to learn from.
errors.FEATURE_ALL_MISSING: That feature has no values at all. ({feature})
errors.HYPERPARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE: {name} is outside the allowed range. ({min}-{max}, yours {actual})
errors.SPLIT_INVALID: The train/test split setting is not valid.
errors.SPLIT_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE: A row number used for training is outside the data. The data may have changed. (row {index}, data has {actualRows} rows)
errors.JOB_NOT_FOUND: That job could not be found.
errors.JOB_MEMORY_EXCEEDED: Training needed more memory than allowed. ({limitMb}MB)
errors.SERVER_DISK_INSUFFICIENT: The server is out of storage space. Please try again shortly.
errors.SERVER_BUSY: The server is busy. Please try again shortly.
errors.SERVER_INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: That working session no longer exists. Please upload your data again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: The session ended after {idleMinutes} minutes of inactivity. Please upload your data again.
errors.SESSION_LIMIT_REACHED: Too many people are connected right now. Please try again shortly.

modelOmission.overBudget: The model was left out to keep the project file small. Train again to use it for predictions.
modelOmission.tooLarge: The model was too big to fit in the file. Training again will not help — try lowering a setting that makes the model bigger, such as the number of trees.
modelOmission.engineUnsupported: This way of training cannot save a model yet, so only the scores were kept.

client.ALGORITHM_NOT_FOR_DATA_TYPE: This model cannot be used with the data you uploaded.
client.ALGORITHM_NOT_FOR_TASK_TYPE: This model cannot be used for the task type you chose.
client.SERVER_UNAVAILABLE: The training server cannot be reached. For now you can train on your computer.
client.DATASET_TOO_LARGE_FOR_BROWSER: The data is too large to train on your computer. (limit {limitRows} rows)
client.ENGINE_NOT_READY: This way of training is not ready yet. Set it up first under training setup.
client.PROJECT_FILE_NOT_ZIP: This file is not a project file.
client.PROJECT_FILE_ENTRY_MISSING: The project file is missing something it needs. ({entry})
client.PROJECT_FILE_INVALID: The project file could not be read. ({path})
client.PROJECT_FILE_VERSION_TOO_NEW: This file was made with a newer version. Update the app and open it again. (file {fileVersion}, this app {appVersion})
client.PROJECT_FILE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: The format version of this file is not recognized. ({fileVersion})
client.MODEL_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: This version cannot run that model. ({format})
client.MODEL_FILE_INVALID: That saved model could not be read. Train it again to use it.
client.DATASET_FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: This file type is not supported. ({fileName})
client.DATASET_SHEET_NOT_FOUND: That sheet could not be found. ({sheetName})
client.STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: There is not enough room left in this browser. (needs {requiredMb}MB, {availableMb}MB free)
client.UNEXPECTED_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
client.SPLIT_TOO_FEW_ROWS: Only {actualRows} rows can be used, which is too few to split into training and test sets. (needs at least {minRows})
client.SPLIT_STRATIFY_IMPOSSIBLE: '{label}' appears only {count} time(s), so the split cannot keep the same proportions. Turn off proportional splitting, or collect at least {minRows} rows with this value.

project.exportDone: The file has been downloaded. You need it to carry on from another computer.
project.exportDropped: Some models were too large to include. Their scores are still there. ({count})
project.openModified: This file shows signs of having been edited after it was saved.
